events.title: World AIDS Day - Free Rapid HIV Testing
events.description: December 1, 2026 | 11 AM - 2 PM Get free and confidential HIV testing at either location and play the Kahoot to snag one of the first 40 free boba drinks available! Free HIV Rapid Testing at Triton Health and Wellness Building and LGBT RC Triton Health and Wellness building’s Multipurpose Room on the 3rd floorLGBT Resource Center, located between Mandeville Center and the Original Student CenterResource Fair on Library Walk and Kahoot Join Health Promotion Services and campus partners to increase awareness and learn more about HIV, Pre-Exposure Prophylaxis (PrEP), and campus resources. Then pick up a red ribbon to show your support in the fight against AIDS. Participate in the World AIDS Day Kahoot (Game Pin: 08847939) to test your knowledge while you wait for your rapid test results. Reduced Cost STI Testing at Student Health Services Lab - Monday, November 30 through Friday, December 4 No-cost HIV testing is also available on Tuesday at Triton Health and Wellness building! Schedule an appointment or walk-in to the lab located on the 1st floor for Self-Directed STI Testing and add on STI testing for $10- $40 this week only – regularly $60 to $205 without UC SHIP or RAFT. Testing Options: Urine Chlamydia and Gonorrhea Testing: $20 Syphilis Testing: $10 HIV Testing: No cost on December 1 or $10 December 2-4

events.title: GIS Mini Expo
events.description: Celebrate UC GIS Week with UC San Diego Library and UC San Diego Young Planners’ Society for a GIS Mini Expo! Drop in for an open expo event to celebrate and learn more about GIS technology. Hear from faculty, researchers, and industry leaders on how it’s used in fields like planning, connect with fellow mapmakers and engage with student work and participate in challenges and live demonstrations. Want to get hands-on with GIS? We recommend bringing your own laptop to make the most of the event’s interactive activities and demonstrations! Snacks and refreshments will be available as supplies last. To help ensure there is enough for everyone, we encourage an RSVP.

events.title: Research in the Arts and Humanities
events.description: Dear students, join us for an informative presentation focused on research opportunities available for undergraduate students majoring in the Arts and Humanities. Have you ever been so invested in a topic that you spend hours reading different articles and books about it? That is research! Make it official by applying to the many opportunities available at the UC San Diego Research Hub. Many of these opportunities offer students stipends and are a good way to make your grad applications stand out, for those planning to extend their education. This event is open to all students of all majors, with an emphasis on the Arts and Humanities. Our presenter, Elizabeth Vazquez, is well acquainted with research opportunities for all majors and specializes in offering help to transfer students. There will be lunch and coffee available for all participants, so do not forget to RSVP by clicking the button above.

events.title: Destress with CLS: Community Hour
events.description: Join Chicanx and Latinx Studies for a cozy community hour! Enjoy hot chocolate, pan dulce, and crafts as we relax, create, and connect in community. Come as you are, take a break from the hustle, and spend some time with the CLS community. Let's Reflect Together Ancestral Knowledge: What wisdom or traditions have you inherited from your family or community that help you navigate difficult times or resist the pressure to always be productive? Collective Care: How do our communities teach us to care for one another? What can we learn from those practices? Redefining Success: What might success look like if we valued rest, relationships, joy, and community just as much as achievement? Take a break, get creative, share your thoughts, and connect with others in a welcoming space. We look forward to seeing you there!

events.title: Sanford Stem Cell Institute Seminar Series: Sohail Tavazoie, MD, PhD
events.description: Mark your calendars for our next speaker in our Sanford Stem Cell Institute Seminar Series! Sohail Tavazoie, MD, PhD, will be at the Sanford Consortium for Regenerative Medicine* on Thursday, December 10 in Duane Roth Auditorium from 9:30–10:30 a.m. PT to speak on Cancer Metastasis as a Heritable Trait Shaped by our Evolutionary Exposure to Infectious Disease. Join us on the terrace for refreshments before the event. *Parking will be enforced Learning Objectives: At the conclusion of the activity, the participants will be able to: Treat patients with stem cells more effectively as a result of multidisciplinary discussionDisseminate the latest research and clinical advances on stem cells and regenerative medicine to promote improved strategies and methodologiesPromote further investigation into topics involving stem cells and regenerative medicineTranslate stem cell and regenerative medicine research from bench to bedside Accreditation Statement: The University of California San Diego School of Medicine is accredited by the Accreditation Council for Continuing Medical Education to provide continuing medical education for physicians. The University of California San Diego School of Medicine designates this live activity for a maximum of 1 AMA PRA Category 1 Credit™. Physicians should only claim the credit commensurate with the extent of their participation in the activity.
